odd_linear_map.definition: f(input) = sum_output phi_output_from_input * output, over all outputs of parity opposite to input
odd_linear_map.scaling_convention: No separate global scale; scaling is absorbed into the independent symbolic coefficients

coboundary.coefficient_format: Exact rational linear combinations of the even phi parameters; terms are ordered by odd_linear_map.parameter_order
